{
  "steps": [
    {"id": 1, "claim": "Determine the number of rice-consuming meals per day for the household.",
     "evidence": "The problem states 5 members eat rice every lunch and dinner. Assuming 1 meal per person per sitting, total meals = 5 members * 2 meals/day = 10 meals/day.",
     "weight": 1.0,
     "depends_on": []},
    {"id": 2, "claim": "Calculate the total daily rice consumption for the household.",
     "evidence": "Each person consumes 0.2 kg per meal. Total daily consumption = 10 meals/day * 0.2 kg/meal = 2.0 kg/day.",
     "weight": 1.0,
     "depends_on": [1]},
    {"id": 3, "claim": "Calculate the number of days a 42 kg bag of rice will last.",
     "evidence": "Total rice available is 42 kg. Days = Total rice / Daily consumption = 42 kg / 2.0 kg/day = 21 days.",
     "weight": 1.0,
     "depends_on": [2]},
    {"id": 4, "claim": "Convert the duration from days to weeks.",
     "evidence": "There are 7 days in a week. Weeks = Days / 7 = 21 / 7 = 3 weeks.",
     "weight": 1.0,
     "depends_on": [3]}
  ],
  "answer": "3",
  "confidence": 1.0,
  "considered": [
    {"answer": "1.5", "reason_rejected": "This would result if one mistakenly calculated consumption for only one meal per day or divided by the wrong number of members."},
    {"answer": "6", "reason_rejected": "This would result if one forgot that there are two meals (lunch and dinner) per day, effectively halving the daily consumption rate."}
  ]
}
